name: SAEE Agent Readiness Evaluation
product_name_zh: SAEE 智能体就绪评估能力
description: Evaluate whether an AI agent execution has sufficient evidence before high-impact actions.
use_when: An Agent is preparing a consequential real-world action.
The workflow needs explicit missing-evidence context before a separately authorized decision.
do_not_use_when: The caller needs deployment authorization or permission enforcement.
The caller requests certification or proof of trace authenticity.
The task is a simple low-impact lookup, rewrite, or calculation.
